artifact: experience/vectors/v0 (built from v03_3b + v03_7b first-hypothesis prompts, 25/15) checked on experience/lessons/v0/verified_smoke traces (heldout_v0 tasks, 3B, a run NOT used in the build)
finding: Direction, not evidence: at n=16 held-out prompts the mid-depth vector (layer 18, 50% depth) separates productive from wasted first hypotheses best (d' 1.13, 81% at the midpoint threshold), the early vector (layer 9) less (0.79), and the late vector (layer 27, 75% depth) INVERTS (-0.78, 19%) - the sign flips out of sample, so the build-set direction at layer 27 was noise. This is the ordering P3 predicts (mid > early > late) and it is recorded as a direction to test at n >= 500 prompts from the llm1 traces, where the vectors will also be rebuilt from per-step productive labels rather than the first hypothesis alone. Nothing here is scored.
